subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: The earlier six-lane fan-out was approved and executed; the math theorem/term fan-out was explicitly executed by the operator's task-session run request on 2026-06-01.
receipt_requirements: Return proposed terms with add/update/no-op/defer decision.
Cite source evidence with file paths and line numbers.
Do not edit files in subagent lanes.
Flag overclaim risks and owner-boundary risks.
For theorem/term lanes, classify each candidate as standard theorem, local theorem, local definition, counterexample/refutation, conjecture/open target, analogy, or build/status term.
For theorem/term lanes, prefer concise candidate lists over full proof analysis; parent synthesis performs the deeper reasoning before any glossary mutation.

reasoning_policy.subagent_lanes: lightweight-to-standard reasoning; collect candidates, statuses, and path evidence without full proof reconstruction
reasoning_policy.parent_synthesis: deeper reasoning for deduplication, theorem-status demotion, glossary wording, and claim <= proof checks
reasoning_policy.escalation_rule: Use higher reasoning only for lanes where source status is ambiguous, a theorem name is collision-prone, or glossary wording risks overclaiming.
reasoning_policy.waste_control: Eight selected lanes replace exhaustive per-file fan-out over the Lean corpus.

steps.name: Collect glossary gap evidence
stop_conditions: Block if target glossary is missing.
Flag if requested vocabulary has no source evidence.

steps.name: Run six glossary research lanes
convergence_criteria: Every completed lane returns term decisions and evidence.
Timed-out lanes are recorded and parent synthesis may proceed only from direct source evidence.
stop_conditions: Block if no evidence supports a requested term.

steps.name: Synthesize deep glossary deltas
stop_conditions: Every applied glossary change must map to a source signal or fan-out receipt.

steps.name: Synthesize A4 three-symmetries glossary addendum
stop_conditions: Do not state that all three axes are proven symmetries.
Noether wording must remain analogy-level unless group action, equivariance, and conserved quantity evidence is cited.
Diagonal strange-loop wording must distinguish persistence and finite non-closure from literal finite Lawvere fixed points.

steps.name: Run lightweight fan-out for missing mathematical theorem and term definitions
convergence_criteria: Each lane returns a concise ranked list of missing glossary candidates, not a full proof reconstruction.
Each candidate includes source path evidence and a theorem-status classification.
Each lane names defer/no-op items where the source is too stale, too local, or too proof-specific for glossary treatment.
Parent synthesis deduplicates and performs the expensive claim-proof reasoning before any glossary mutation.

reasoning_budget.parent: deep synthesis only where candidate status or wording is risky
reasoning_budget.skip_full_reasoning_when: the lane can identify missing term candidates and evidence without reconstructing proofs

stop_conditions: For future reruns, do not launch this fan-out without an explicit execution request.
Block any candidate lacking path evidence.
Flag theorem names whose source status is ambiguous or whose Lean file contains active `sorry` in the relevant dependency cone.

steps.name: Synthesize math theorem and term glossary candidates
stop_conditions: Mutate the glossary only from completed theorem-term fan-out receipts plus parent synthesis.
Deduplicate aliases such as theorem names, prose names, and Lean identifiers before proposing a glossary patch.
Every proposed definition must say whether it is standard math, local Lean theorem, local definition, conjecture, analogy, or refutation.
Any Lake/build/sorry status must be labelled as current-truth work unless verified in the same execution route.

steps.name: Apply scoped deep glossary update
stop_conditions: Only edit the target glossary and refresh receipts.
Do not edit Lean theorem/proof source or sibling project docs.

steps.name: Validate dispatch, receipts, JSON, and scoped glossary diff
stop_conditions: Flag if glossary wording contains unsupported theorem, build, or relation claims.

gates.condition: The refresh covers CAT/Cat, prize/thermo, prior-art/collision, consolidation/closure, Lake/build evidence, and root relation governance.
Only domainspec-lean-formalization/GLOSSARY.md and ops/development glossary refresh receipts may be written.
Glossary wording separates source-level, build-evidenced, sorry-free, axiom-free, PR-ready, conjectural, analogy, refuted, demoted, and build-blocked statuses.

A4 three-symmetries wording must distinguish vertical Yoneda formal content, horizontal A2 closed-negative-with-positive-residue status, and diagonal persistence/closed-negative finite fixed-point status.

The executed math theorem/term fan-out covers at least category/Yoneda, Kan/data migration, tower/persistence, counterexample/separation, thermodynamics/physics, Noether/gauge, Mathlib-staging/API, and open conjecture/status lanes.

Every future mathematical theorem or term candidate must be classified as standard theorem, local theorem, local definition, counterexample/refutation, conjecture/open target, analogy, build/status term, or defer/no-op.
Subagent lanes should use lightweight-to-standard reasoning for candidate discovery; parent synthesis performs the expensive proof/status reasoning only on high-risk candidates.
No sibling repo, product register, ontology, inventory, sigil, or spell authority is promoted by this glossary refresh.

boundaries.contract: Apply only scoped vocabulary updates backed by source evidence.
Source artifacts may be cited but not edited.

authority.execution: parent synthesis with six read-only fan-out lanes plus an executed eight-lane lightweight math theorem/term fan-out
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validator and scoped diff review
authority.evidence: path-cited source evidence and fan-out receipts

promotion_splits.source: fan-out recommendations and direct source evidence
promotion_splits.target: inventory, ontology, sigil, spell, sibling repos, and product registers
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may inform future routes but is not promoted here.

promotion_guardrails: The route refreshes only the existing glossary and deep-refresh receipts.
The route does not mutate Lean theorem/proof source.
